title: Specify aspect ratio and duration up front (e.g., 16:9, 30-second) to lock the…
content:
Specify aspect ratio and duration up front (e.g., 16:9, 30-second) to lock the output format in Seedance 2.5.

Force a single-take look by explicitly prompting ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT and banning cuts/hidden cuts, whip pans, lens changes, and camera resets/teleports.

Control camera behavior by describing a specific camera style and path (e.g., uninterrupted controlled handheld pursuit shot with smooth sidesteps/retreats/arcs/drops/rises/pivots) and explicitly requiring continuous physical follow without snapping.

Maintain character consistency by instructing Keep one identical [character] throughout and repeating key identity descriptors (face/body/hair/wardrobe/weapon hand).

Prevent duplicate enemies by setting an exact count and uniqueness constraint (e.g., Exactly 36 distinct orcs; never reuse an orc; each has different weapon/helmet/armor/silhouette).

Enforce readable action beats by requiring one-target-per-strike and enumerating exact counts of contacts/defeats (e.g., 36 separate contacts, releases, and individual defeats; no multi-target cut).

Reduce unwanted blur by explicitly prompting No motion blur anywhere and requiring sharply resolved subjects/particles.

Guide complex choreography by listing the exact techniques to rotate through and adding a constraint like without adjacent repetition.

Create “teleport” relocations without showing travel by prompting a two-flash rhythm: flash fully hides the subject → camera continues with environment visible → second local flash reveals subject at the next target, and explicitly banning transit body movement and whip pan.

Improve scene readability in crowds by prompting depth staging (e.g., enemies occupy successive depth pockets, not one flat crowd; only nearby attackers are readable).

Get more reliable long action by breaking the prompt into timed beats (e.g., Beat 1–5 with 0–3s, 3–10s, etc.) while reiterating CONTINUE SAME SHOT each beat.

Constrain VFX timing/causality by specifying triggers (e.g., green fluid begins only at sword contact; flashes cover only the princess during vanish/reveal).

Lock the aesthetic by explicitly requesting clear daylight, photoreal live-action, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, clean HDR contrast, natural textures, and excluding haze/grain/compression artifacts.

es.content:
Especifica la relación de aspecto y la duración desde el principio (por ejemplo, 16:9, 30 segundos) para fijar el formato de salida en Seedance 2.5.

Fuerza un aspecto de toma única indicando explícitamente ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT y prohibiendo cortes/cortes ocultos, whip pans, cambios de lente y resets/teleports de cámara.

Controla el comportamiento de la cámara describiendo un estilo y una trayectoria específicos (por ejemplo, una toma de persecución handheld controlada e ininterrumpida con sidesteps/retreats/arcs/drops/rises/pivots suaves) y exigiendo explícitamente un seguimiento físico continuo sin saltos.

Mantén la consistencia del personaje indicando Keep one identical [character] throughout y repitiendo los descriptores clave de identidad (rostro/cuerpo/cabello/vestuario/mano del arma).

Evita enemigos duplicados estableciendo un conteo exacto y una restricción de unicidad (por ejemplo, Exactly 36 distinct orcs; never reuse an orc; each has different weapon/helmet/armor/silhouette).

Impón beats de acción legibles exigiendo one-target-per-strike y enumerando conteos exactos de contactos/derrotas (por ejemplo, 36 separate contacts, releases, and individual defeats; no multi-target cut).

Reduce el desenfoque no deseado indicando explícitamente No motion blur anywhere y exigiendo sujetos/partículas nítidamente resueltos.

Guía la coreografía compleja enumerando las técnicas exactas que deben rotarse y añadiendo una restricción como without adjacent repetition.

Crea relocaciones tipo “teleport” sin mostrar el trayecto indicando un ritmo de dos flashes: flash fully hides the subject → camera continues with environment visible → second local flash reveals subject at the next target, y prohibiendo explícitamente el movimiento corporal de tránsito y el whip pan.

Mejora la legibilidad de la escena en multitudes indicando depth staging (por ejemplo, los enemigos ocupan sucesivos depth pockets, no una multitud plana; solo los atacantes cercanos son legibles).

Consigue una acción larga más fiable dividiendo el prompt en beats temporizados (por ejemplo, Beat 1–5 con 0–3s, 3–10s, etc.) mientras reiteras CONTINUE SAME SHOT en cada beat.

Restringe el timing/causalidad de los VFX especificando triggers (por ejemplo, el fluido verde comienza solo al contacto de la espada; los flashes cubren solo a la princesa durante vanish/reveal).

Bloquea la estética solicitando explícitamente clear daylight, photoreal live-action, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, clean HDR contrast, natural textures, y excluyendo haze/grain/compression artifacts.

fr.content:
Spécifiez dès le départ le format d’image et la durée (par ex. 16:9, 30 secondes) afin de verrouiller le format de sortie dans Seedance 2.5.

Imposez un rendu en prise unique en demandant explicitement ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT et en interdisant les cuts/cuts cachés, les whip pans, les changements d’objectif et les resets/téléportations de caméra.

Contrôlez le comportement de la caméra en décrivant un style et un trajet précis (par ex. une poursuite handheld contrôlée et ininterrompue avec des sidesteps/reculs/arcs/descendes/montées/pivots fluides) et en exigeant explicitement un suivi physique continu sans snapping.

Maintenez la cohérence du personnage en indiquant Keep one identical [character] throughout et en répétant les descripteurs clés de l’identité (visage/corps/cheveux/tenue/arme en main).

Évitez les ennemis dupliqués en définissant un nombre exact et une contrainte d’unicité (par ex. Exactly 36 distinct orcs; never reuse an orc; each has different weapon/helmet/armor/silhouette).

Imposez des beats d’action lisibles en exigeant one-target-per-strike et en énumérant des comptes exacts de contacts/défaites (par ex. 36 separate contacts, releases, and individual defeats; no multi-target cut).

Réduisez le flou indésirable en demandant explicitement No motion blur anywhere et en exigeant des sujets/particules nettement résolus.

Guidez une chorégraphie complexe en listant les techniques exactes à enchaîner et en ajoutant une contrainte du type without adjacent repetition.

Créez des déplacements “teleport” sans montrer le trajet en demandant un rythme à deux flashes : flash fully hides the subject → camera continues with environment visible → second local flash reveals subject at the next target, tout en interdisant explicitement le mouvement de transit du corps et le whip pan.

Améliorez la lisibilité de la scène dans les foules en demandant un depth staging (par ex. les ennemis occupent des poches de profondeur successives, pas une foule plate ; seuls les attaquants proches sont lisibles).

Obtenez des actions longues plus fiables en découpant le prompt en beats chronométrés (par ex. Beat 1–5 avec 0–3s, 3–10s, etc.) tout en répétant CONTINUE SAME SHOT à chaque beat.

Contraignez le timing/la causalité des VFX en précisant les déclencheurs (par ex. green fluid begins only at sword contact; flashes cover only the princess during vanish/reveal).

Verrouillez l’esthétique en demandant explicitement clear daylight, photoreal live-action, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, clean HDR contrast, natural textures, et en excluant haze/grain/compression artifacts.

ja.content:
アスペクト比と尺を最初に明示しておく（例: 16:9、30秒）ことで、Seedance 2.5で出力フォーマットを固定する。

ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT を明示的にプロンプトし、カット／隠しカット／whip pan／レンズ変更／カメラのリセットやテレポートを禁止して、ワンテイクの見た目を強制する。

特定のカメラスタイルと移動経路を記述してカメラ挙動を制御する（例: smooth な sidesteps／retreats／arcs／drops／rises／pivots を伴う、途切れのない制御された handheld pursuit shot）とともに、急な切り替えなしに連続した物理的追従を明示的に要求する。

Keep one identical [character] throughout と指示し、顔／体／髪／衣装／武器を持つ手などの主要な識別要素を繰り返すことで、キャラクターの一貫性を維持する。

正確な数と一意性の制約を設定することで、敵の重複を防ぐ（例: Exactly 36 distinct orcs; never reuse an orc; each has different weapon/helmet/armor/silhouette）。

一撃ごとに1ターゲットを徹底し、接触数／撃破数の正確なカウントを列挙することで、読み取りやすいアクションのビートを強制する（例: 36 separate contacts, releases, and individual defeats; no multi-target cut）。

No motion blur anywhere と明示的にプロンプトし、被写体／粒子がシャープに解像されていることを要求して、不要なブレを減らす。

回転させる正確な技法を列挙し、without adjacent repetition のような制約を加えることで、複雑な振り付けをガイドする。

移動を見せずに「テレポート」的な再配置を作るには、2回のフラッシュのリズムをプロンプトする: flash fully hides the subject → camera continues with environment visible → second local flash reveals subject at the next target, そして移動中の身体の動きと whip pan を明示的に禁止する。

群衆の中でのシーンの見やすさを高めるには、奥行きのステージングをプロンプトする（例: 敵は1枚の平面的な群衆ではなく、連続する奥行きのポケットに配置される; 読み取れるのは近くの攻撃者だけ）。

長尺のアクションをより安定させるには、プロンプトを時間付きのビートに分割する（例: Beat 1–5 with 0–3s, 3–10s, etc.）一方で、各ビートで CONTINUE SAME SHOT を繰り返す。

VFX のタイミング／因果関係を制御するには、トリガーを明示する（例: green fluid begins only at sword contact; flashes cover only the princess during vanish/reveal）。

美的要素を固定するには、clear daylight、photoreal live-action、crisp high-resolution cinema detail、clean HDR contrast、natural textures を明示的に要求し、haze／grain／compression artifacts を除外する。

ko.content:
출력 형식을 Seedance 2.5에서 고정하려면, 먼저 화면비와 길이를 명시하세요(예: 16:9, 30초).

ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT를 명시적으로 프롬프트에 넣고, 컷/숨은 컷, 휩 팬, 렌즈 변경, 카메라 리셋/텔레포트를 금지해 싱글 테이크처럼 보이도록 강제하세요.

특정 카메라 스타일과 이동 경로를 설명해 카메라 동작을 제어하세요(예: 매끄러운 사이드스텝/후퇴/아크/드롭/라이즈/피벗이 포함된, 끊김 없는 컨트롤드 핸드헬드 추적 샷) 그리고 끊김 없이 물리적으로 계속 따라가도록 명시적으로 요구하세요.

Keep one identical [character] throughout를 지시하고, 핵심 정체성 설명(얼굴/몸/머리카락/의상/무기를 쥔 손)을 반복해 캐릭터 일관성을 유지하세요.

정확한 수와 고유성 제약을 설정해 중복되는 적이 나오지 않도록 하세요(예: 정확히 36명의 서로 다른 오크; 같은 오크를 절대 재사용하지 말 것; 각자 무기/헬멧/갑옷/실루엣이 모두 다를 것).

one-target-per-strike를 요구하고, 접촉/제압의 정확한 횟수를 열거해 읽기 쉬운 액션 비트를 강제하세요(예: 36번의 개별 접촉, 해제, 그리고 각각의 제압; 다중 타깃 컷 금지).

No motion blur anywhere를 명시적으로 프롬프트에 넣고, 피사체/입자가 선명하게 분해되어 보이도록 요구해 원치 않는 블러를 줄이세요.

정확히 사용할 기술을 나열하고 without adjacent repetition 같은 제약을 추가해 복잡한 안무를 안내하세요.

이동 과정을 보여주지 않고 “텔레포트”식 재배치를 만들려면, 두 번의 플래시 리듬을 프롬프트하세요: 플래시가 피사체를 완전히 가림 → 카메라는 환경이 보이는 상태로 계속 진행 → 두 번째 로컬 플래시가 다음 목표 지점에서 피사체를 드러냄, 그리고 이동 중 몸의 움직임과 휩 팬을 명시적으로 금지하세요.

군중 장면의 가독성을 높이려면 깊이 배치를 프롬프트하세요(예: 적들이 하나의 평면적인 군중이 아니라 연속된 깊이 구역에 배치되며, 가까운 공격자만 읽을 수 있게 보일 것).

긴 액션을 더 안정적으로 만들려면 프롬프트를 시간대별 비트로 나누세요(예: Beat 1–5 with 0–3s, 3–10s, etc.) 그리고 각 비트마다 CONTINUE SAME SHOT를 반복하세요.

VFX의 타이밍/인과관계를 제어하려면 트리거를 명시하세요(예: 녹색 액체는 검이 닿는 순간에만 시작될 것; 플래시는 소멸/재등장 시 공주만 가릴 것).

미학을 고정하려면 맑은 낮, photoreal live-action, 선명한 고해상도 시네마 디테일, 깨끗한 HDR 대비, 자연스러운 텍스처를 명시적으로 요청하고, haze/grain/compression artifacts는 제외하세요.

pt.content:
Especifique a proporção e a duração logo no início (por exemplo, 16:9, 30 segundos) para travar o formato de saída no Seedance 2.5.

Force uma aparência de take único promptando explicitamente ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT e proibindo cortes/cortes ocultos, whip pans, mudanças de lente e resets/teleports de câmera.

Controle o comportamento da câmera descrevendo um estilo e um trajeto específicos de câmera (por exemplo, uninterrupted controlled handheld pursuit shot with smooth sidesteps/retreats/arcs/drops/rises/pivots) e exigindo explicitamente acompanhamento físico contínuo sem snapping.

Mantenha a consistência do personagem instruindo Keep one identical [character] throughout e repetindo descritores-chave de identidade (face/body/hair/wardrobe/weapon hand).

Evite inimigos duplicados definindo uma contagem exata e uma restrição de unicidade (por exemplo, Exactly 36 distinct orcs; never reuse an orc; each has different weapon/helmet/armor/silhouette).

Imponha beats de ação legíveis exigindo one-target-per-strike e enumerando contagens exatas de contatos/derrotas (por exemplo, 36 separate contacts, releases, and individual defeats; no multi-target cut).

Reduza o desfoque indesejado promptando explicitamente No motion blur anywhere e exigindo sujeitos/partículas nitidamente resolvidos.

Oriente coreografias complexas listando as técnicas exatas a serem alternadas e adicionando uma restrição como without adjacent repetition.

Crie relocations de “teleport” sem mostrar o deslocamento promptando um ritmo de dois flashes: flash fully hides the subject → camera continues with environment visible → second local flash reveals subject at the next target, e proibindo explicitamente movimento corporal de transição e whip pan.

Melhore a legibilidade da cena em multidões promptando depth staging (por exemplo, enemies occupy successive depth pockets, not one flat crowd; only nearby attackers are readable).

Torne a ação longa mais confiável dividindo o prompt em beats cronometrados (por exemplo, Beat 1–5 with 0–3s, 3–10s, etc.) enquanto reitera CONTINUE SAME SHOT em cada beat.

Restrinja o timing/causalidade de VFX especificando gatilhos (por exemplo, green fluid begins only at sword contact; flashes cover only the princess during vanish/reveal).

Trave a estética solicitando explicitamente clear daylight, photoreal live-action, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, clean HDR contrast, natural textures, e excluindo haze/grain/compression artifacts.

zh.content:
请在一开始就明确指定画幅比例和时长（例如 16:9、30 秒），以在 Seedance 2.5 中锁定输出格式。

通过明确提示 ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT，并禁止 cuts/hidden cuts、whip pans、镜头切换以及 camera resets/teleports，来强制单镜头效果。

通过描述具体的 camera style 和 path 来控制镜头行为（例如 uninterrupted controlled handheld pursuit shot with smooth sidesteps/retreats/arcs/drops/rises/pivots），并明确要求持续的物理跟随，不能突然跳切。

通过指示 Keep one identical [character] throughout，并重复关键身份描述（face/body/hair/wardrobe/weapon hand），来保持角色一致性。

通过设定精确数量和唯一性约束来防止敌人重复（例如 Exactly 36 distinct orcs; never reuse an orc; each has different weapon/helmet/armor/silhouette）。

通过要求 one-target-per-strike，并列出接触/击败的精确数量（例如 36 separate contacts, releases, and individual defeats; no multi-target cut），来确保动作节奏清晰可读。

通过明确提示 No motion blur anywhere，并要求主体/粒子都清晰锐利，来减少不必要的模糊。

通过列出需要轮换的具体技巧，并添加 without adjacent repetition 之类的约束，来引导复杂编排。

通过提示一种 two-flash rhythm 来实现“teleport”式位移而不显示移动过程：flash 完全遮住主体 → 镜头继续，环境可见 → 第二次局部闪光在下一个目标点揭示主体，并明确禁止 transit body movement 和 whip pan。

通过提示 depth staging 来提升拥挤场景的可读性（例如，敌人分布在连续的深度层次中，而不是挤成一片平面人群；只有附近的攻击者需要清晰可读）。

通过把 prompt 拆成带时间的节拍（例如 Beat 1–5，分别为 0–3s、3–10s 等），同时在每个节拍重复 CONTINUE SAME SHOT，来获得更稳定的长动作表现。

通过指定触发条件来约束 VFX 的时机与因果关系（例如，green fluid 只在 sword contact 时开始；闪光只在 princess vanish/reveal 时覆盖她）。

通过明确要求 clear daylight、photoreal live-action、crisp high-resolution cinema detail、clean HDR contrast、natural textures，并排除 haze/grain/compression artifacts，来锁定整体美学风格。
